title: PostgreSQL
intro: PostgreSQL interview questions go beyond generic SQL — MVCC and the PostgreSQL transaction model, JSONB indexing strategies, partitioning (declarative + inheritance), the rich window-function vocabulary, replication (streaming + logical), backup and PITR strategy, query planning with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, and the Spring Boot + HikariCP tuning patterns that surface in real interviews. This page is the one to use when the job description specifies Postgres (which is most of them in 2026).
